title: #74 slice 4: publish the external verdict (ledger, room, PR)
body:
Implements [§9 of the design](docs/design/74-external-review.md). Part of #74; depends on slice 3.

- Map the reviewer's judgment to `external_review_judged`, with `{judgment, rationale, head_sha, merge_base, pr_number, verifier, verifier_family, author_families}`.
- The narrator posts the verdict to the room.
- The ingest worker posts a PR comment naming the SHA, judgment, rationale, verifier and ledger event id. It carries a marker so it is posted once, and states that a new push voids the verdict.
- Delete `refs/swarm/external/<task_id>` once the task is terminal.
